observations: Runtime-trace mode only: no browser opened, no request sent by this agent. All operations below derive from evidence files already captured by storefront-explorer / portal-explorer.

Two network_ref files that upstream evidence claims to exist could NOT be verified: raw/network/ACT-101-004.json (referenced by storefront-evidence.json SF-OBS-104) and raw/portal/network/orders-get-4322.json (referenced by portal-evidence.json OBS-102/ACT-P-002). Both are absent from the filesystem — confirmed via directory listing (raw/network/ is empty; raw/portal/network/ contains only graphql-calls-around-fulfill-click.json and orders-list-response.json). Treated as missing evidence, not fabricated to fill the gap.

The most operationally significant finding: around the 'Confirm & Send to fulfill' click (ACT-P-004) on an order-item with no connected POD provider, only two read-only GraphQL 'get' queries (orders_by_pk re-fetch, order_item_activities re-fetch) were observed. No mutation, and no Printify/POD-provider network call, was observed. This is scoped strictly to the disconnected-POD state; the connected-POD branch was never exercised and must not be inferred from this.
unknowns: Full request/response body of POST /cart/add (ACT-101-004) — network_ref file raw/network/ACT-101-004.json does not exist on disk; only a DOM/browser-network-tool textual summary (variant_id, quantity, price, customization image URL pattern) is available from storefront-evidence.json SF-OBS-104. No headers, no full JSON body.

Full nested response schema of GraphQL orders_by_pk (ACT-P-002) — network_ref file raw/portal/network/orders-get-4322.json does not exist on disk. Only root-field NAMES are known (orders_by_pk, order_items, customization, order_item_artworks, tib_status, fulfillment_status, fulfillment_shipping_method) from graphql-calls-around-fulfill-click.json's 'purpose'/'query_root_fields_of_interest' description, not an actual captured payload.

Which of the two order_item_activities variants (summary/limit-1 vs full/no-limit-with-content) was the one re-invoked around the ACT-P-004 fulfill click — the capture file does not disambiguate by timestamp or call order.

portal-evidence.json's ACT-P-004 network_entry_labels declares mapped=2, unrelated=3 (5 total network entries), but graphql-calls-around-fulfill-click.json only enumerates 3 GraphQL calls + 1 REST endpoint reference (4 items). The extra/unaccounted entries (what the 3 'unrelated' entries actually are) are not identifiable from provided evidence.

No raw HTTP request headers (Authorization, cookies) are present in any evidence file for any operation. Auth is inferred only from portal_context.verified_by (localStorage teeinblue_token JWT, sub=273) in portal-evidence.json, not from a captured request header. Marked INFERRED, not observed.

Explicit HTTP status code / status line is not literally recorded in any evidence JSON (no headers block, no status field). '200' is inferred from successful response bodies and successful UI render, not from a captured status line — flagged as an assumption baked into observed_status rather than a directly logged value.
Behavior of 'Confirm & Send to fulfill' when a real Printify (or other POD) account IS connected — never observed. Do not extend the 'no mutation observed' finding to that branch.
ACT-P-005 (Change status dropdown) — zero network activity observed since no option was selected; target endpoint/method for actually changing status is completely unknown.

No documented/OpenAPI contract exists for any of these operations (ZERO_DOC_BOOTSTRAP, no prior product-kb) — 'documented_observed_mismatches' is empty because there is nothing authoritative to diff against, not because everything matched.
